thread:
maria_partnerships: Quick check-in after today's cross-org hardware + marketplace sync. Need to lock: GA vs limited preview plan, pricing bands, and APAC driver readiness. @leo_hw @vikram_si please weigh in.
leo_hw: TL;DR: H100 GA (global) still OK, H200 delivery is staggered in APAC (firmware/driver backlog). MI300 on our side ready but needs a final quantization test for 8-bit variants. B200 requires microcode 1.2.3 and updated power table.
anya_product: Product asks: can we bundle a "Managed SI Install" option in marketplace metadata? Customers want turnkey install + on-site certification. If yes, need SKU naming that matches SI offer.
vikram_si: SI concerns: on-site installs require a certified firmware image + rack-level thermal profile. Our test lab shows B200 draws +7% peak in sustained probe. Suggest holding B200 in Limited Preview until thermal mitigations validated.
sam_ops: Ops note: reserve 3 racks in us-west-2 and 2 racks in ap-southeast-1 for validation. Also we need a driver rollback plan for H200 in case APAC customers hit regressions.
maria_partnerships: Proposal: rollout order -> MI300 limited preview (marketplace LP), Gaudi limited preview, H100 GA, H200 LP (APAC only), B200 withheld from GA. Embargo window proposal: May 12-18 for LP comms, GA press on May 26.
leo_hw: Agree to order but ask for two things: (1) explicit marketplace metadata flag `on_site_si: true|false` and (2) `driver_support: {h100: stable, h200: apac-limited, mi300: candidate}` in metadata.
anya_product: We'll need price bands for LP vs GA. Draft: LP = list price -10% / GA = list price. Also add a certified-install surcharge SKU.
vikram_si: SI schedule: validation harness tag `redwood/si/validate-hardware-2025-05-06`. On-site training partners: PartnerX confirmed for US, PartnerZ pending for APAC. Estimated SI-ready date for MI300 + Gaudi: 2025-05-10.
announce-bot: draft announcement checklist created: /announcements/drafts/3623456789-hw-marketplace-rollout. Items: metadata PR, LP pricing sheet, SI partner certs, firmware signoff, embargo approval.

Sample marketplace YAML (for review):
```yaml
marketplace_sku: gaudi-managed-4x
listing_name: "Gaudi Managed 4x"
on_site_si: true
regions: [us-west-2, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1]
requires_firmware: "mc-1.2.3"
driver_support: {h100: stable, h200: apac-limited, mi300: candidate}
pricing: {lp_discount: 0.10, ga_multiplier: 1.0}
```

leo_hw: I'll open PR for metadata + firmware gating: https://git.redwood/marketplace/meta/pulls/88. Will attach thermal logs and microcode package.
vikram_si: tagging @PartnerX for US install readiness. PartnerZ pinged for APAC - will escalate.
anya_product: I'll send draft pricing to finance and comms by EOD. Need final copy by May 8 for GA runway.
sam_ops: Reserving racks now; will post rack IDs and power headroom in the ops channel.
maria_partnerships: Thanks team. Follow-ups: leo -> PR + thermal logs, vikram -> SI partner confirmations, anya -> pricing + comms copy, sam -> rack IDs. Reconvene next Fri unless blockers pop up. :calendar:
